headline: Ethereum leads TVL at $37.3B on 2026-11-17
summary: Ethereum holds the top position in chains by TVL at $37.29B, followed by Base at $5.17B and Solana at $4.77B. Uniswap V3 recorded the highest DEX volume at $924M in 24h while Tether generated $17M in fees. USDT leads stablecoins with $175.2B circulating and several assets show peg deviations. Base leads L2 TVS at $13.16B amid multiple protocol incidents in the past fortnight.
